title: Refined product purchase bar
summary: Improve the sticky price and Add to cart bar with calmer typography and a cleaner button.

changes.detail: Use a larger semibold price with smaller decimal digits, a readable unit-price label, more horizontal padding, gentler bar corners and shadow, and a 52px green button with clearer text.
Remove the bag icon background circle and button shadow. Preserve exact localized prices, safe-area padding and existing cart/preorder/loading states.
